scope_choices: This is automated model review, not independent human verification, replication, or clinical validation.
This synthesis considered all supplied text for physical pages 1–17 and all page-image review notes. Earlier API calls, not this text-only synthesis, received the page images.
Batch-local unavailable-page statements in earlier notes do not describe combined coverage: the supplied upstream coverage spans all 17 pages, seven figures, Table 1, declarations, and references.
The supplied source hash was retained, not recomputed. No filesystem, repository, supplement, landing page, or cited publication was accessed.
No executable schema, quotation matcher, cross-reference validator, graph builder, or regression tests were run.

All 128 feature definitions were considered. Assertions a092:001–128 cover the primary contribution; a092:129–140 preserve necessary temporal-specification distinctions rather than a second comprehensive trained-model review.

Evidence e092:19 now quotes the supplied Figure 1 caption. Its previous graphical-interior quotation was not verifiable from supplied full text and has not been retained as verified verbatim evidence. Annual/monthly graphical details remain explicitly attributed to upstream image-review notes.
Synthetic generator distributions, parameters, dependencies, seeds, record counts, and versioned assets are insufficiently reported.
Partition construction, information availability, preprocessing boundaries, fusion fitting, and independent calibration/test separation are insufficiently documented.
Lag-history state and indexed temporal prediction are specified. Fitting/execution and target alignment remain unresolved; neither latent dynamics nor recursive rollout is required for L1.
The 2025 methods description, upstream Figure 1 annual/monthly descriptions, and seasonal equation do not resolve cadence or evaluated forecast lead time.

Actual surveillance, laboratory, mortality, climate, satellite-data integration and full Bayesian inference are proposed future work. Style labels do not establish full algorithms or particular software packages.
Approximate graphical readings were not converted into exact error metrics, sample sizes, coverage percentages, or corrected burden totals.
Nominal intervals and qualitative inclusion do not establish accepted calibration, aleatoric/epistemic separation, or joint trajectory coverage.
Unnamed benchmarks do not establish independent external or actual-human validation.
Equation (9) describes at least one infection under independence, not specifically concurrent multiple infections; dependence and attribution-overlap handling need clarification.
Somaliland's 53 hospitalizations and 47 severe cases are retained. Outcome definitions are insufficient to adjudicate an error.
Generated population denominators are not enrollment counts or independently verified national demographics.
R1 is supported; no R2–R8 facet is established. R0 is not inferred from conceptual language in an implemented synthetic experiment.
Matched action comparison, identified policy effects, prospective care use, clinical utility, and operational authorization are not established.
The author-stated ethics position is not a named authority-specific exemption. Article licensing does not establish code, parameter, or dataset licensing.
All eleven references were considered as bibliographic content, not retrieved evidence. Cited studies' methods and prospective designs are not inherited.
